rows.summary: Drain软预算和父进程硬超时相同，已提交的run/lease可在硬杀后残留。
details: Correct subclaim: daemon passes the same local_drain_timeout_seconds to --max-seconds and subprocess.run(timeout); loop checks only before each complete run_once cycle. Actual daemon child timeout probe leaves committed run=running, lease=active, finally marker absent; next lease acquisition is skipped_active_lease.

Correct subclaim: retention excludes running agent_runs; source search finds no daemon startup reconciliation of abandoned agent_runs. dispatch_inflight is committed before spawn and, when encountered later, changes execution binding to attention/dispatch_outcome_unknown.

Unsupported/inaccurate: a cycle starting at 170 seconds is killed only if it exceeds the remaining deadline, not inevitably. Repo lease expiry is acquisition+540 seconds by default; post-kill delay is the remaining TTL, not another full 9 minutes. The orphan-run health query is instrumentation, not evidence that production already observed orphans.

Evidence limit: probe invokes actual daemon.run_child_json and actual lease helpers in a temporary child, rather than reproducing the entire 180-second production drain; exact outer/inner budget equality and finally location are source verified.
rows.proposed_fix_assessment: Keep graceful shutdown, bounded external calls, reserved shutdown margin and abandoned-run reconciliation. A fixed 60-second margin alone cannot bound a blocking fetch; propagate deadlines. Before marking prior runs failed/releasing ownership, prove previous owner and descendants stopped and reconcile possible external effects; never blanket-finalize all running rows.

rows.summary: 全局默认45分钟确实限制90分钟worker配置，但这是明确声明的上限策略。
details: Correct subclaim: supervise.classify_attempt computes min(global timeout, launch timeout); fresh heartbeat plus runtime=45 minutes, global=45, launch=5400 returns failed_timeout and timeout_seconds=2700.

Counterevidence to bug interpretation: docs/reference.md:185 declares an independent supervision wall-time limit; :197-198 explicitly states increasing workers timeout alone does not raise global hard timeout. docs/multi-model-review.md:54 explicitly preserves parent total time while waiting for slots. docs/reference.md:197-198 is already documented in commit 9484286a (2026-10-23), not a new post-report correction.

Historical new-pr P95=5015 and a production causal claim of widespread repeated work were not verified by this scope; deployed hard_timeout_minutes is unknown. Default45 does not establish actual production setting.
rows.proposed_fix_assessment: Reject changing to attempt timeout precedence as an ordinary bug fix: it changes the documented global cap. A diagnostic showing effective=min(global,worker), a configuration warning, and an explicit operator choice of parent budget are compatible follow-ups. Policy change requires a separate behavioral decision.

rows.summary: 持续超过10秒的SQLite写锁可使正常等待中的多模型review整轮失败并终止同轮模型。
details: Actual _wait invokes check_active, which validates owner then UPDATEs heartbeat through store.connect(timeout=10). sqlite3.OperationalError is outside review_one caught types; outer Coordinator.run catches Exception and marks session failed, then terminate_children.

Real temporary SQLite writer held 11 seconds; actual Coordinator.run -> _wait -> check_active raised OperationalError: database is locked, session became failed and an actual registered independent model process exited via SIGTERM (-15); measured11.05 seconds.

Boundary: not every short lock collision causes failure; it must outlast the10-second connection wait. Source-supported source paths holding writer across I/O are separately assigned B/I/8/root finding.
rows.proposed_fix_assessment: Do not skip check_active wholesale on lock failure: that is also the active-attempt/cancellation fence. Separate heartbeat persistence from ownership validation, use bounded contention handling, retain cancellation checks, and fix long writer transactions first. 30-60-second heartbeat is a design option, not a demonstrated required value.

rows.summary: Leader退出但仍有未验证后代时会保留容量并进入人工attention；直接killpg建议不满足身份边界。
details: Correct subclaim: dead recorded leader is never authority to signal an unknown remaining group. _dispatch_process_status detects live group, returns unknown/unverified_descendants_running, supervisor records attention while leaving attempt running; admission counts running regardless of attention.

Inaccurate: after binding attention the task is excluded by runnable_sql and active claim; it is not necessarily repeatedly processed by ordinary local supervision. orphaned_command_running is a different branch for discovered command records and is bounded by hard timeout unless cleanup remains unverified.

Counterevidence to proposed fix: worker_identity requires PID, PGID, process start token and command fingerprint. model_execution._group_finished invokes killpg(pgid,0) only as observation, not authority to kill. Numeric PGID==old PID alone does not prove the same owner after restart/reuse.

Existing controlled real-process tests explicitly require refusal to terminate unverified orphans; tests.test_process_termination ran3 tests successfully in2.240 seconds. Thus retained capacity is an intentional safety choice, though recovery operability can be improved; indefinite occupancy depends on descendants remaining alive and no operator cleanup.
rows.proposed_fix_assessment: Reject automatic killpg from a numeric PGID and unconditional failed/capacity release after a timer. Preserve fail-closed ownership; improve persisted descendant identities/explicit operator recovery, and release capacity only after confirmed exit or an explicitly authorized attestation.

rows.summary: Classification父任务提交完成后Git准备失败，会留下无法被本地runnable探测唤醒的可恢复状态。
details: Actual finalization first consumes events/wakeup and completes parent; _create_child_task_for_recommended_route commits before _prepare_worktree, then only creates child. That pre-I/O commit is necessary to avoid writer locks across Git, but there is no durable runnable successor intent.

Simulated Git failure in actual _prepare_worktree call gave failed_route, parent completed, child count0, only wakeup consumed; has_runnable_local_work=False. A subsequent manual run_once recovered and dispatched1 child through _recover_orphaned_classification_results.

Latency depends on next external poll/other runnable work and configuration; default external schedules are300/600 seconds, but another active local task or explicit run can recover sooner. Repeated fetch requires persistent preparation failure; does not prove unavoidable duplicate network work after successful recovery.
rows.proposed_fix_assessment: Keep the commit before external Git I/O. Add a durable handoff/recovery intent or teach local eligibility to detect this accepted completed classification with no child, including bounded retry scheduling and attention on deterministic failure; do not restore one giant transaction across fetch.

limits: Original historical percentile/online occurrence claims not verified
All real child processes created by probes were reaped/cleaned
